🇪🇺 Piketty’s new global-economy scenario asks a radical question: can prosperity rise while inequality falls?

Thomas Piketty and the Global Justice Project model a 2100 scenario where average monthly income converges toward €5,000 per person worldwide, annual working hours fall roughly by half, and the bottom 50% owns 30% of global wealth instead of about 2%.
